{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
set -e
export FLASHINFER_DISABLE_VERSION_CHECK=1
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate base
cd /root/schema-dag-extraction

# Drop stale file cache to avoid cgroup OOM (120GB limit)
python3 -c "
import os, ctypes
libc = ctypes.CDLL('libc.so.6', use_errno=True)
POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED = 4
total = 0
for d in ['/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache', '/root/autodl-tmp/models']:
    if not os.path.isdir(d): continue
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(d):
        for f in files:
            fp = os.path.join(root, f)
            try:
                fd = os.open(fp, os.O_RDONLY)
                size = os.fstat(fd).st_size
                libc.posix_fadvise(fd, 0, size, POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED)
                os.close(fd)
                total += size
            except: pass
print(f'Dropped {total/1024**3:.1f}GB file cache')
"

MODEL=/root/autodl-tmp/models/llama-3.1-8b-instruct/LLM-Research/Meta-Llama-3___1-8B-Instruct
MODEL_NAME=llama-3.1-8b-instruct
COMMON="--dataset fewnerd --prompt_version v2 --types_file configs/few_nerd_types.json --embeddings_path artifacts/type_embeddings.pt --sim_matrix_path artifacts/sim_matrix.pt --model_path $MODEL --model_name $MODEL_NAME --max_samples 1000 --max_model_len 4096 --gpu_memory_utilization 0.85 --output_dir artifacts/exp012"

mkdir -p artifacts/exp012

echo "===== [$(date)] exp-012-r2 exp1: Count Baseline ($MODEL_NAME) ====="
python3 src/run_experiment.py --mode exp1 $COMMON

echo "===== [$(date)] exp-012-r2 exp2: Confusability Controlled ($MODEL_NAME) ====="
python3 src/run_experiment.py --mode exp2 $COMMON

echo "===== [$(date)] exp-012-r2 DONE ====="
", "stderr": "", "return_code": 0}, "error": null, "metadata": {"elapsed_seconds": 0.41}}
